text: 今日はとても静かな朝でした。窓の外では雨が降っています。
<|speaker:0|> Did you lock the door? <|speaker:1|> I thought you did! <|speaker:0|> Well, I didn't.
[whispers] Keep your voice down. They can hear everything from the hallway.
[laughs] No, no, that's not what I meant at all.
[deep, low male voice] The storm reached the coast just after midnight.
La biblioteca cierra a las ocho, así que tenemos que darnos prisa.
